summary: Iteration 232 - Batch 20 (Self Check-in v2 Pre-arrival) tested. Backend: 20/20 passed. Frontend: All UI elements verified. Admin panel shows pipeline with KPI cards (total arrivals, links sent, reg-cards filled, completed). Guest-facing 5-step wizard works end-to-end: Welcome → Reg-card → Signature → Slot → Done. Public endpoints work without auth. Invalid token returns 404 with friendly error page.

issues: Clipboard write permission error in automated testing (expected behavior in headless browser)

critical_code_review_comments: Default expiry is 72 hours, configurable via query param
Public endpoints (verify, reg-card, slot) don't require auth - correct for guest access
Status flow: issued → started → reg_card_filled → completed
Signature captured as PNG base64 data URL from HTML canvas
Guest profile patched when reg-card submitted (if guest_id exists)
fast_track_enabled set on booking when flow completed
